title: LIT on Tradeify Growth 50K (eval + funded)
question: Which accounts should run LIT next to the MFFU Builder 50K, and what do they pay a month net of fees?
verdict: Tradeify Growth 50K: eval p10/f10 H1 44.5/2.3 H2 42.3/0.0, eventual pass 74.2 / 88.5%, pass_med 8.0 / 12.0; funded MC 6 months $615 / $716 a month, lost 1.7 / 2.5%; 6 months from purchase net of fees $458 / $495 a month (H1 / H2). Not usable for the bot: Tradeify bans running the same bot at other firms (help center 'Guidelines for Traders').
notes: tools/lit_funded_firms.py; stored trades = back-to-back real history (eval sized by the plan's eval sizing is not stored; only the funded trades). The run library's eval columns are not this plan's numbers: those are in the verdict and research/lit/funded_firms.json.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
